subject: Request: temporary on-call headcount override for Nov holiday window
messages:
From: ops+oncall@blueorchard.com
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com
Cc: sarah.lin@blueorchard.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:43:00 -0500
Subject: Temporary headcount shortfall Nov 24-27 — request for SLA adjustment

Hi Camila,

We're expecting a reduced on-call headcount during the Thanksgiving week (Nov 24-27) due to multiple planned PTOs across the team. We ran several drills and estimate coverage will drop to 60% of normal for the P2 window overnight (02:00-08:00 CET).

Blue Orchard is asking if Redwood can approve a temporary, limited SLA modification for that four-day window: allow P2 response up to 90 minutes (instead of our standard 60) for incidents classified as non-customer-impacting (ticketed degradations) and require immediate P1 handling as usual. We'll attach our roster and proposed fallback runbook.

What we need from Redwood:
- Confirmation of whether you can permit the temporary exception and under what guardrails.
- Any monitoring/telemetry we must keep enabled while exception is in place.
- Escalation expectations if the situation degrades to repeated incidents.

Attachments: blueorchard-oncall-roster.csv, proposed-exception-playbook.pdf

Appreciate a response by EOD Wed (18 Nov) so we can finalize internal rotations.

Thanks,
Sarah Lin
Ops Manager — Blue Orchard
ops+oncall@blueorchard.com


From: camila_reyes@redwood.com
To: ops+oncall@blueorchard.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:10:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Temporary headcount shortfall Nov 24-27 — request for SLA adjustment

Sarah — thanks for the clear note and for the attachments. I've looped Ben (support lead) and Rishi (ops) to assess operational risk and guardrails. Quick initial thoughts:

- We can consider a narrow, timeboxed exception provided Blue Orchard enables full telemetry (incident traces + synthetic alerts) and grants Redwood permission to run temporary active failover to a dedicated pool if we detect repeated regressions.
- We will not change P1 handling — P1 remains 15-minute response.
- If approved, we'll require a short runbook addendum, a 48-hour pre-window readiness check, and a post-window incident review to avoid recurring carveouts.

Ben/Rishi: can you review the playbook and roster and confirm whether the telemetry + automatic failover clause is sufficient from your side? Also flag any legal/contract concerns so we can loop Legal if needed.

I'll hold reply to Blue Orchard until we have internal sign-off (aiming EOD Wed).

Best,
Camila Reyes
Strategic Customer Success
Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:07:00 -0500
Subject: Fwd: Temporary headcount shortfall Nov 24-27 — request for SLA adjustment

Camila — reviewed the attachments. Notes:

- Roster looks accurate. There are two critical overnight shifts (02:00-06:00 CET) with single coverage on Nov 25 and 26 — that's where the risk is concentrated.
- Proposed mitigation that I want enforced before we approve:
  * Blue Orchard must enable our synthetic suite (page-on-failure) for the two overnight windows and grant our SREs access to their alerting channel for the holiday window.
  * If any P2 is observed to repeat more than twice in 6 hours, automatic fallback to Redwood Dedicated pool triggers and we resume standard SLA; Blue Orchard consumes additional burst quota while fallback is active.
- Operationally we can commit to relaxing P2 to 90 minutes for the specified 4-day window, conditional on the above.

Laura — any contract language concerns with temporary automatic failover and burst quota consumption?

Ben Carter
Support Lead, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com


From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Temporary headcount shortfall Nov 24-27 — request for SLA adjustment

All — legal is comfortable with a timeboxed operational exception provided Blue Orchard signs an addendum that covers:

1) Exact window (2026-11-24 00:00 CET through 2026-11-27 23:59 CET)
2) Explicit telemetry requirements (synthetics + traces + alert channel access)
3) Agreement that automatic fallback to Dedicated and any burst usage will be billable per existing committed rates and that Redwood can trigger it based on SRE-determined thresholds.
4) A required post-window incident review with customer-facing write-up within 5 business days (to determine whether exception is repeated).

Once the addendum is countersigned, Legal approves. I'll draft language and attach to DocuSign.

– Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: camila_reyes@redwood.com
To: ops+oncall@blueorchard.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 17:06:00 -0500
Subject: Approval (conditional) — temporary P2 response window Nov 24-27

Sarah — thanks for the quick turnaround. Redwood can approve a conditional, timeboxed modification to the P2 response SLA for Nov 24–27 as you requested. Summary of approved terms (please confirm):

- Window: 2026-11-24 00:00 CET through 2026-11-27 23:59 CET.
- Temporary P2 target: 90 minutes for non-customer-impacting degradations only. P1 commitments remain unchanged (15-minute acknowledgment).
- Preconditions (must be met at least 48 hours before window start):
  * Blue Orchard enables Redwood synthetic checks for primary customer flows and grants read + alert access to Redwood SREs for the holiday channels.
  * Blue Orchard accepts the automated fallback clause: Redwood may trigger Dedicated pool failover if P2 incidents repeat (repeat defined as >2 P2 incidents in a rolling 6-hour window).
  * Any Dedicated fallback and resulting burst usage will be billable under the account's existing committed rates.
  * DocuSign addendum countersigned agreeing to the above and committing to the post-window incident review.

- Escalation path while exception active:
  1) On-duty Support (Ben) -> if unresolved after 90 minutes escalate to Redwood SRE (Rishi) via the shared channel.
  2) If SRE determines repeated degradation, SRE triggers Dedicated pool fallback and pages engineering on-call if required.
  3) Camila (CS) will be notified immediately and will coordinate customer communications and credits if applicable.

I'll attach the draft addendum and DocuSign link after Laura finalizes language. If you confirm acceptance of these guardrails, we'll prepare the DocuSign for signatures and run the readiness check on Nov 22.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Strategic Customer Success
Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachments: proposed-exception-playbook.pdf (redlined), draft-addendum-docusign-link
